body: This is blocking being able to test e2e migrations cc @dakrone

I have been able to reproduce this, when I change https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/ec27e20c80f402e09822f5e1b4ebc7b02fc6196d/x-pack/plugin/deprecation/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/deprecation/DeprecationInfoAction.java#L369 to include hidden indices, then it sees the hidden index. Hopefully it will be a simple fix in that case.
